business_summary: Northeast Community Bancorp, Inc. operates as the holding company for NorthEast Community Bank that provides financial services for individuals and businesses. It accepts various deposit instruments, including checking accounts, money market accounts, regular savings accounts, and non-interest-bearing demand accounts, as well as certificates of deposits. The company also offers construction, commercial and industrial loans, multifamily and mixed-use real estate, non-residential real estate loans, and consumer loans. In addition, it invests in various types of liquid assets, including U.S. Treasury obligations, municipal securities, deposits at the Federal Home Loan Bank of New York, and certificates of deposit of federally insured institutions, as well as securities of various federal agencies, and state and municipal governments. Further, the company offers life insurance products and fixed rate annuities. It operates full-service branches located in Bronx, New York, Orange, Rockland, and Sullivan Counties in New York, Essex, Middlesex, and Norfolk Counties in Massachusetts; and loan production offices located in White Plains, New York; New City, New York; and Danvers, Massachusetts. Additionally, the company provides services such as personal loans and overdraft protection, and utilizes brokered, listing service, and military deposits, as well as borrowings, sources of funds, and retail deposit products. Northeast Community Bancorp, Inc. was founded in 1934 and is headquartered in White Plains, New York.
business_summary_ko: Northeast Community Bancorp, Inc.는 개인과 기업에 금융 서비스를 제공하는 NorthEast Community Bank의 지주 회사로 운영됩니다. 당좌 예금 계좌, 머니 마켓 계좌, 일반 저축 계좌, 무이자 수요 계좌 등 다양한 예금 수단과 예금 증서를 허용합니다. 이 회사는 또한 건설, 상업 및 산업 대출, 다세대 및 복합 용도 부동산, 비거주 부동산 대출 및 소비자 대출을 제공합니다. 또한 미국 재무부 채권, 지방자치단체 증권, 뉴욕 연방 주택 대출 은행 예금, 연방 보험 기관의 예금 증서, 다양한 연방 기관, 주 및 지방 정부의 증권을 포함한 다양한 유형의 유동 자산에 투자합니다. 또한 회사는 생명 보험 상품과 고정 금리 연금을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 뉴욕의 Bronx, New York, Orange, Rockland 및 Sullivan 카운티, 매사추세츠의 Essex, Middlesex 및 Norfolk 카운티에 위치한 풀 서비스 지점을 운영하고 있습니다. 뉴욕 화이트 플레인스에 위치한 대출 업무 사무소; 뉴욕주 뉴시티; 매사추세츠 주 댄버스
